title: Counting writer
hints: A decorator does the real work by calling the wrapped value: `n, err := c.W.Write(p)`. Your job is only to remember `n`.
Add `int64(n)` to `c.N` **before** looking at `err`, then return `n, err` unchanged. Handle `c.W == nil` first: count `len(p)` and return `len(p), nil`.
`Measure`: `cw := &CountingWriter{W: w}; err := write(cw); return cw.N, err`. Pass the pointer: only `*CountingWriter` has the `Write` method.
